subject: Problem in fitting a uniform detection function using R

messages.author: 0c18e4ee4c678e70
messages.subject: Problem in fitting a uniform detection function using R
parts:
Hello, 

after having updated the Distance package for R, I'm having troubles in fitting a uniform detection function to my data.

I get the following error:

Error in apply(gosolnp_rndpars, 1, FUN = function(x) .safefun(x, fun,  : 
  dim(X) must have a positive length


As a test I tried to fit the same uniform detection function also to the ducknests and minke whales data, getting the same error.

Do you have any idea about what the problem could be?

Thank you very much
Nathalie

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Problem in fitting a uniform detection function using R
parts:
Hi Nathalie and list members,

This bug seems to only affect uniform+cosine detection functions when there is one adjustment and is down to a bug in the Rsolnp package that we use for optimisation. I have implemented a work around in mrds (which Distance uses to do it's fitting).

You can find an updated version of the mrds package for Windows here:

https://github.com/DistanceDevelopment/mrds/releases/download/mrds-2.1.11/mrds_2.1.11.zip

and for Mac/Linux users here:

https://github.com/DistanceDevelopment/mrds/archive/mrds-2.1.11.tar.gz

Please do let me know if you have any further problems.


best,
--dave
